verdict.rationale: Slack's docs explicitly state AI takes huddle notes with key takeaways, action items, and speaker attribution automatically organized when a huddle ends, plus daily recaps/summaries of channels and threads for missed content. This directly matches the story of getting AI notes/recaps for attended or missed meetings. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of huddle note accuracy/quality, and no explicit mention of recaps for formal 'meetings' (calls) beyond huddles/channels.
